participation.context: Read the second book on his feet, and gave in.

story.body: You stood at the board and read. You did not copy a stanza. You decided to buy the book.

title: Read the second book standing and decided to buy

participation.context: Paid two shillings while still on his feet, refused the number, and refused the envy.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named the lack of a laugh, asked the number, and did not get it.
participation.name: Michael Drayton

participation.context: Repeated the March warning, and left the book to the chamber.

story.body: You paid two shillings and left the stall with the book. You gave Drayton five minutes and no number. You did not envy the smooth stanza. Harrison was done once the coin was leaving the board.

participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You held a place in Daniel and a place in the chronicle. You took no line down. The cat stayed on the heavy book.

title: Read Daniel and the chronicle together
